title: THE RECON DOG: the opening re-paced round the dog's survey
context: Owner, 2026-11-10, note 2 on THE SETTLING (f55e80e3): "there is nothing to do until the Stalheart is built, that does not work ... a) we land, b) ISAO builds the Recon Dog c) the player can control the dog to go explore in 3rd person. d) it bumps into low level White and Yellow enemies. e) Isao decides to build a wall f) we need to build a Rotor Gun, too much for the recon dog g) we man the rotor (as before)"; his calls: the Stålheart prints AFTER the Rotor fight, the dog SURVEYS MARKED POINTS (the last wakes the first Whites and Yellows), the player sets the pace, not a clock. Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-the-recon-dog-opening-design.md; branch recon-dog-opening from 8c3b4cef, unpushed.
outcome: BUILT. On the story's own start (an arrival from `landed` with no ?settle=N) the beats run foundry -> dog-print -> scouting -> contact -> walled -> printing ... cleared -> harvest -> orders -> quiver-piloting (src/domain/story-beats.js `scout`, STORY_PHASES). Isao prints RECKON K9 with the companions' forced print (COMPANIONS.prints.order k9, c07, k0, mech; C-07 a day after it at the expedition); the seat src/fx/dog-scout.js reads the tank's keys (W A S D, Shift the sprint at the K9's 5.5 m/s, the cruise), drives the K9 through companions.driven, holds a live chase shot `dogScout`, rings the three points and marks them on the HUD; the rules are pure (src/domain/dog-scout.js: the state machine, the motion, 2 s in a 6 m ring surveys a point, the knock-down, the points' and the pack's cells), the numbers DOG_SCOUT (src/content/dog-scout.js). The third survey wakes 8 whites and 4 yellows six hops beyond the gate on the lane (harmless, the Pearl pace); the dog home (3 cells) or 60 s on lets go of the seat and the gate prints (OPENING_PROGRAMME: gate at walled, depot at harvest, Stålheart at quiver-piloting, src/domain/build-programme.js openingSteps); Isao's Rotor once the gate stands (dog_rotor, his grant); the tremor path as before, the pack and the fodder one wave. After the clear the depot prints, 150 kg of the wave's bodies are laid outside the gate and Isao's flare sends the rover (src/fx/first-harvest.js, rover-glue lay); its first trip home opens THE FIRST ORDERS (no Rotor card); the card closed, the Quiver's cores and the Stålheart's 75 s print begin together and sector 0 plays under it. The whole salvage at the deploy as THE SETTLING. Chapters, SKIP TUTORIAL, static stages and jumps: the K9 born at once. An acceptance page without &dog=1 has the K9 born at once and the surveys counted (no close-up, no seat). ?settle=N keeps THE SETTLING's opening for comparison (--settling tests it). Deviations from the spec: the points stand on the clearing (8-12 hops is inside its 19; outside it there is one lane); the pack rises beyond the gate, not beyond the last point; the landers' tour plays before the dog's print; the Stålheart begins at the Quiver's beat (at `orders` it was claimed in the frame the card opened); the harvest's 150 kg is laid (the first wave paid the bank before the depot stood) and the flare goes on the first open cell outside the gate, not the richest ground; no ?skip=dog chapter.
alternatives: The points outside the clearing as the spec's table says: the story planet's clearing reaches 19 walking hops and outside it there is a single lane, so three points 8-12 hops out and 60 degrees apart can only stand on the clearing.
The Stålheart at `orders`: claimed by Isao in the frame the card opened (the programme ticks after the card pauses), so it began before the player chose; moved to `quiver-piloting`.
Removing THE SETTLING's clock with its rule: kept behind ?settle=N (its suite still passes) so the two openings can be compared; the owner may remove it.

The acceptance pages driving the dog themselves (an autopilot): a headless clock makes a 100 m drive minutes of wall; they survey at once unless &dog=1, as they pass THE FIRST ORDERS by unless &first=1.
